title: Learned neutrino reconstruction probes simulated top–W correlations
summary: Conditional normalizing flows reconstructed missing neutrino momenta in simulated top–W production. Nonclassical correlation measures remained nonzero across the studied mass bins, with substantial reconstruction bias at low mass. This is leading-order phenomenology, not an LHC observation.
organization: Shanghai Institute for Advanced Studies; University of Science and Technology of China

evidence.tested: Simulated13TeV events supplied learned momentum reconstruction and truth-versus-reconstruction comparisons of negativity and geometric discord.
evidence.unknown: No collision-data measurement. Low-mass biases can be large; flat systematic assumptions, omitted next-to-leading-order interference and incomplete detector uncertainties limit projected sensitivity. Monte Carlo resampling is not independent experimental replication.
evidence.ai_role: The conditional flow infers otherwise underconstrained neutrino momenta needed for angular density-matrix reconstruction.

source_review.scope: Primary v1 model/training Methods, quantum-observable Results/Table4 and limitations; current exact version/date metadata.
